title: Rollback
purpose: Select an exact approved rollback candidate after application unavailability without rebuilding or broadening release scope.

entryEvidence.observation: A bounded incident record identifies rollback for the exact policy and release identity.
An approved retained candidate provides exact source, artifact, checksum, policy, and rollback identities.
The bounded operations projection classifies the application unavailable across the fixed region set.

boundedActions.instruction: Record the incident reason, current policy identity, current release identity, and unavailable application classification once.
Verify the approved retained candidate bytes, checksums, source identity, policy identity, and release receipt once.
Select only the exact approved retained rollback candidate for a separately authorized release workflow.
Request separate approval for the exact rollback candidate, destination, and verification plan.

stopConditions.observation: Stop if any retained byte, checksum, source, policy, release, destination, or receipt identity is absent or inconsistent.
Stop as ready for a receipt only after the exact rollback identity classifies the fixed-region application available.

rollbackActions.instruction: Keep the last independently verified public bytes unchanged if rollback selection or verification fails.
